messages.subject: For Cath Bozanich | Sustainability, corporate affairs and international copper execution
messages.body:
Dear Sandfire Communications Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Ms. Cath Bozanich, Chief Sustainability Officer.

Sandfire's international copper portfolio places sustainability, corporate affairs, community confidence and government relationships close to long-term operating performance. Those priorities align strongly with the work I lead today across a major mining operation.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities span government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory. I coordinate complex stakeholder and regulatory matters across operations, environment, HSE, legal, finance, HR, procurement, security and technical teams, while maintaining senior institutional relationships. I also support stakeholder governance around a large solar and battery-storage platform and coordinated a carbon-accounting evidence pilot using physical operating records.

I would value a senior discussion about where this combination of sustainability, corporate affairs, government relations and social performance might support Sandfire's international priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Sandfire Resources.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
